meta.templateCaveat: Template requirements (e.g. 'a sacrifice outlet') are reported as named missing capabilities, not auto-matched against the pool; full template evaluation is a later phase.

prerequisites.notable: An opponent has a library size which is larger than or equal to their life total.

produces: Near-infinite card draw for target opponent
Near-infinite draw triggers for target opponent
nearMisses.steps:
Cast Peer into the Abyss by paying {4}{B}{B}{B}, targeting an opponent whose library size is larger than or equal to their life total.
Resolve Peer into the Abyss, causing that opponent to draw cards equal to half their library size and causing them to lose half their life total, rounded up.
Orcish Bowmasters triggers for each card drawn, dealing 1 damage to the opponent for each card drawn this way and putting that many +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

prerequisites.notable: You control a nontoken permanent that can be cast using {C}.

nearMisses.steps:
Cast Sol Ring by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning a nontoken permanent that can be cast using {C} from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Cast the nontoken permanent returned in step 2 by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning Sol Ring from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

nearMisses.steps:
Cast Doomsday Excruciator by paying {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}{B}.
When Doomsday Excruciator enters, it triggers, causing each player to exile all but the bottom six cards of their library.

cards.name: One Ring to Rule Them All

prerequisites.notable: You have the largest deck size or are tied for the largest deck size.

nearMisses.steps:
Cast Body of Research by paying {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U}, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token, then putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to your deck size.
Cast One Ring to Rule Them All by paying {2}{B}{B}, which enters the battlefield with a lore counter on it.
One Ring to Rule Them All's first chapter ability triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you, then causing the Fractal to become your Ring-bearer, then causing each player to mill cards equal to the Fractal's power.
